```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.path = "figures/",
  message = FALSE,
  dpi = 192,
  fig.width = 5,
  fig.height = 3,
  out.width = 500
)
```

## (a) Varying smoothness $s$

```{r figure3-a}
library(tidyverse)

df <- readRDS("rds/fig3a.rds") |> 
  group_by(s, method) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(relative_mse), sd = sd(relative_mse), se = sd / sqrt(n), 
            lower = mean - 1.96 * se, upper = mean + 1.96 * se, .groups = "drop")

ggplot(df, aes(s, mean, color = method, linetype = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.03, 0.6, 1.2, 3.6), 
                     labels = c(0.03, 0.6, 1.2, 3.6),
                     minor_breaks = NULL) +
  scale_color_discrete(palette = scales::hue_pal()(2) |> rev()) +
  xlab("Smoothness (non-transferable component)") + ylab("Relative MSE") +
  theme_bw()
```

## (b) Varying magnitude $M$


## (c) Varying unlabeled sample size $n_A$

```{r figure3-c}
df <- readRDS("rds/fig3c.rds") |> 
  group_by(n_A, method) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(relative_mse), sd = sd(relative_mse), se = sd / sqrt(n), 
            lower = mean - 1.96 * se, upper = mean + 1.96 * se, .groups = "drop")

ggplot(df, aes(n_A, mean, color = method, linetype = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1600, 3200, 6400, 12800),
                     labels = scales::comma(c(1600, 3200, 6400, 12800)),
                     minor_breaks = NULL) +
  scale_color_discrete(palette = scales::hue_pal()(2) |> rev()) +
  xlab("Sample size of (X, Z) data") + ylab("Relative MSE") +
  theme_bw()
```
